player_prompt.intro:
Oe o le Ta'aloga {player_id} i le JoJoJoin, ta'alo i luga o le laupapa 5x5 ma sela numera mai 0-24.
I lou taimi, tu'u lou fa'ailoga i so'o se sela tuufaatasi, e.g. '[12]'.
OE MANUMALO pe a e maua e fa o lou fa'ailoga i se laina — e fa sela tutusa i le fa'asologa i le itu, i luga poo i lalo.
O le Ta'aloga {player_id} oe o le '{symbol}'; o lou fili o le '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E lē o saʻo le faatulagaga ua tuuina mai.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} e lē o se sela saʻo. E tatau ona i le va 0 ma 24.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ua uma ona nofoia le sela {cell}.

game_action.placed: Pela {player_id} na tuu lona faʻailoga ({symbol}) i totonu o selo {cell}.
